note: Where this project stands in relation to work that already exists. Every entry is drawn from research/04-bibliography (BIBLIOGRAFIJA_2026-09-05.md, LITERATURE_THEORY_METHODS_2026-09-06.md, BIBLIOGRAPHY_SENSING_CONTEXT_2026-09-06.md and the master bibliography) and carries its own primary link, so a reader can check it without asking us. The 'takes' line says what this project took from it; it is not a claim that the authors endorse or know of this project. Entries are ordered by kind, not by importance.

claim_boundary.standard_sr: Čitanje javnih fidova i stranica po rasporedu, tabla sa poslednjim vrednostima, mapa, otvoren kod. To rade gradske table i urbane opservatorije godinama i ovaj projekat ne tvrdi drugačije.
claim_boundary.standard_en: Polling public feeds and pages on a schedule, a dashboard of latest values, a map, open code. City dashboards and urban observatories have done this for years and this project does not claim otherwise.
claim_boundary.ours_sr: Dozvola se hvata kao bajtovi pre svakog čitanja i presuđuje u tri stanja, a knjiga zahvata se samo dopisuje. Odsustvo je pozitivan zapis sa svojim razlogom, nikada nula. Svaka vrednost nosi tri vremena i jedno od pet stanja, pa se prijem nikada ne prikazuje kao merenje. Komentar lokalnih modela prolazi kroz kapiju koja mu dopušta samo brojeve iz digesta i citate unutar teksta. Po ovome se sme sporiti — zato ovako i piše.
claim_boundary.ours_en: Permission is captured as bytes before any reading and decided in three states, and the ledger is append-only. Absence is a positive record with its own reason, never a zero. Every value carries three times and one of five states, so a reception is never shown as a measurement. The local models' commentary passes a gate that admits only numbers from the digest and citations inside the text. These are the claims worth disputing — which is why they are written this plainly.
claim_boundary.not_sr: Ne tvrdi se da je ovo merenje grada: ovo je ono što su instrumenti objavili i kad smo to primili. Ne tvrdi se da su izvori obavešteni pojedinačno — nisu; poštuju se samo njihova javno objavljena pravila. Ne tvrdi se da su lokalni modeli tačni: svaka njihova rečenica se proverava i odbija se kad ne prođe. I ne tvrdi se da je pokrivenost potpuna — popis otvorenosti postoji upravo zato što nije.
claim_boundary.not_en: It is not claimed that this measures the city: it is what the instruments published, and when we received it. It is not claimed that the sources were individually notified — they were not; only their publicly published rules are honoured. It is not claimed that the local models are correct: every sentence of theirs is checked, and refused when it fails. And it is not claimed that coverage is complete — the audit of openness exists precisely because it is not.
claim_boundary.problem_sr: Grad ne postaje razumljiv time što dobije još instrumenata. Beograd već ima državnu mrežu za vazduh, meteorološke i hidrološke stanice, aerodrom koji svakih pola sata javlja vreme, distribuciju koja objavljuje sutrašnja isključenja ulicu po ulicu, vodovod koji sam javlja kvarove, parking koji broji slobodna mesta i građanske senzore. Ono što stanovnik i dalje ne može jeste da odgovori na prosto pitanje — kakav je vazduh u mom delu grada sada, koliko je iko u to siguran i kada je to zapravo izmereno — i da na osnovu toga odluči. Nedostatak nije u čulima nego u zapisu: vremena znače različite stvari, poreklo se ne navodi, odsustvo se ne vidi, a uslovi korišćenja nisu nigde upisani. Zato je ovo pre svega projekat zapisa, a tek onda prikaza.
claim_boundary.problem_en: A city does not become knowable by acquiring more instruments. Belgrade already has a state air quality network, meteorological and hydrological stations, an airport reporting the weather every half hour, a distribution utility publishing tomorrow's outages street by street, a water utility announcing its own failures, a parking operator counting empty spaces and a citizen sensor network. What a resident still cannot do is answer a simple question — is the air bad in my part of the city right now, how sure is anyone, and when was it actually measured — and decide on the answer. The gap is not in the senses but in the record: times mean different things, provenance is unstated, absence is invisible, and the terms of reuse are written down nowhere. This is therefore a records project first and a display project second.

entries.name: Chicago Array of Things
entries.what_sr: Gradska mreža senzorskih čvorova sa javnim katalogom uređaja i istorijom njihovog rada.
entries.what_en: A city sensor-node network with a public device catalogue and a history of each node's operation.
entries.takes_sr: Uređaj mora imati datum poslednjeg dokaza života, istoriju zamene i verziju kalibracije — otuda potvrda i za neuspeh, i kvorum po taktu.
entries.takes_en: A device must carry a last-proof-of-life date, a replacement history and a calibration version — hence a receipt even for a failure, and a quorum per slot.

entries.name: Sage / SAGE Continuum
entries.what_sr: Distribuirana mreža čvorova koji obradu rade na licu mesta i objavljuju izvedene signale, ne sirovi snimak.
entries.what_en: A distributed node network that computes at the edge and publishes derived signals rather than raw capture.
entries.takes_sr: Jedno čulo daje više izvedenih signala, i svaki mora nositi identitet algoritma koji ga je napravio; kamera okrenuta nebu nije nadzor ljudi.
entries.takes_en: One sense yields several derived signals, and each must carry the identity of the algorithm that made it; a camera facing the sky is not surveillance of people.

entries.name: Barcelona Smart Citizen
entries.what_sr: Građanska platforma za senzore sa otvorenim katalogom sposobnosti uređaja.
entries.what_en: A citizen sensing platform with an open catalogue of device capabilities.
entries.takes_sr: Katalog sposobnosti se drži odvojeno od kataloga tela: jedan uređaj može nositi više čula, i broj zapisa nije broj uređaja.
entries.takes_en: The catalogue of capabilities is kept apart from the catalogue of bodies: one device can carry several senses, and a count of records is not a count of devices.

entries.name: City of Melbourne pedestrian counting
entries.what_sr: Dugogodišnje javno brojanje pešaka po senzorskim mestima, sa otvorenim istorijskim nizovima.
entries.what_en: A long-running public pedestrian count per sensor site, with open historical series.
entries.takes_sr: Meri se intenzitet i smer, ne jedinstveni ljudi; i rezolucija od jednog minuta nije kašnjenje od jednog minuta — otuda razdvojeno vreme merenja i vreme prijema.
entries.takes_en: It measures intensity and direction, not unique people; and a one-minute resolution is not a one-minute latency — hence measurement time and reception time kept apart.

entries.name: Sensor.Community
entries.what_sr: Globalna mreža jeftinih građanskih senzora vazduha sa otvorenim podacima; u ovom projektu je to izvor S04, koji se stvarno čita.
entries.what_en: A global network of low-cost citizen air sensors with open data; in this project it is source S04, and it is actually read.
entries.takes_sr: Građanski senzor se prikazuje kao građanski senzor, odvojen od referentne mreže, i nikad se ne meša sa državnim merenjem u istu vrednost.
entries.takes_en: A citizen sensor is shown as a citizen sensor, kept apart from the reference network, and never merged with a state measurement into one value.

entries.name: OGC SensorThings API
entries.what_sr: Standard koji razdvaja senzor, posmatrano svojstvo, merenje i lokaciju.
entries.what_en: A standard that separates the sensor, the observed property, the measurement and the location.
entries.takes_sr: Pojmovi reda su uzeti odatle (datastream, phenomenonTime, resultTime), ali se usklađenost ne proglašava zato što JSON ima slična imena.
entries.takes_en: The row's vocabulary is taken from it (datastream, phenomenonTime, resultTime), but conformance is not declared merely because the JSON has similar names.

entries.name: W3C PROV-O
entries.what_sr: Ontologija porekla: ko je šta napravio, iz čega i kada.
entries.what_en: A provenance ontology: who made what, from what, and when.
entries.takes_sr: Knjiga zahvata i lanac od bajtova do reda su pisani da se kasnije mogu preslikati na ovaj model, a da se to preslikavanje testira, ne pretpostavi.
entries.takes_en: The ledger and the chain from bytes to row are written so they can later be mapped onto this model, and so that the mapping is tested rather than assumed.

entries.name: Gabrys, J. (2016). Program Earth. University of Minnesota Press.
entries.what_sr: Merenje menja koji odnosi u okolini postaju vidljivi i na koje se može delovati.
entries.what_en: Sensing changes which environmental relations become noticeable and actionable.
entries.takes_sr: Beleži se i raspored merenja, ne samo uređaj: izbor mesta, posmatrač, postupak i ono što je isključeno — otuda pitanje šta ostaje nevidljivo kad grad predstavljaju dostupni fidovi.
entries.takes_en: The sensing arrangement is recorded, not only the device: the choice of place, the observer, the procedure and what is excluded — hence the question of what stays invisible when the city is represented by whatever feeds are reachable.

entries.name: Gabrys, J. (2019). How to Do Things with Sensors. University of Minnesota Press.
entries.what_sr: Instrument nije ništa bez prakse, održavanja i ljudi oko njega.
entries.what_en: An instrument is nothing without the practice, the maintenance and the people around it.
entries.takes_sr: Prekinut signal može opisivati pokvarenu praksu merenja, a ne odsustvo pojave u gradu — zato tišina ima svoj razlog upisan uz nju.
entries.takes_en: An interrupted signal may describe a broken sensing practice rather than an absence in the city — so silence carries its reason written beside it.

entries.name: Offenhuber, D. (2023). Autographic Design. MIT Press.
entries.what_sr: Materijalni tragovi i sami mogu biti prikaz dokaza, koji čini proizvodnju podatka vidljivom.
entries.what_en: Material traces can themselves be evidence displays, making the production of data visible.
entries.takes_sr: Prikaz treba da pokaže kako je vrednost nastala, a ne samo koliko iznosi — otuda tri vremena, stanje i dozvola uz svaku vrednost.
entries.takes_en: A display should show how a value came about, not only what it is — hence three times, a state and a permission beside every value.

entries.name: Akidau, T. et al. (2015). The Dataflow Model. VLDB.
entries.what_sr: Vreme događaja i vreme obrade nisu isto; kasni podaci i prozori su pravilo, ne izuzetak.
entries.what_en: Event time and processing time are not the same; late data and windows are the rule, not the exception.
entries.takes_sr: Zakazano vreme nije vreme izvora: `phenomenonTime`, `resultTime` i `receivedTime` stoje odvojeno u svakom redu.
entries.takes_en: A scheduled time is not the source's time: phenomenonTime, resultTime and receivedTime stand apart in every row.

entries.name: Patel, S. et al. (2024). Hygroscopic growth calibration for low-cost PM2.5 sensors. AMT 17, 1051.
entries.what_sr: Vlaga, aerosol i godišnje doba menjaju odnos jeftinog senzora prema referentnom instrumentu.
entries.what_en: Humidity, aerosol and season change how a low-cost sensor relates to a reference instrument.
entries.takes_sr: Koeficijenti iz jednog podneblja se ne preslikavaju na Beograd; građanska merenja se ne kalibrišu tiho, nego se prikazuju kakva jesu.
entries.takes_en: Coefficients from one climate are not transferred to Belgrade; citizen measurements are not quietly calibrated but shown as they are.

entries.name: Ljubešić, N. & Lauc, D. (2021). BERTić. BSNLP.
entries.what_sr: Regionalni jezički model za bosanski, crnogorski, hrvatski i srpski.
entries.what_en: A regional language model for Bosnian, Croatian, Montenegrin and Serbian.
entries.takes_sr: Tekst se obrađuje u pismu u kojem je poslužen, oba pisma se testiraju, a normalizovani indeks nikad ne zamenjuje izvorni dokaz.
entries.takes_en: Text is handled in the script it was served in, both scripts are tested, and a normalised index never replaces the original evidence.

entries.name: Overeem, A., Leijnse, H. & Uijlenhoet, R. (2016). Rainfall mapping from microwave links. AMT 9, 2425.
entries.what_sr: Telekomunikacijska infrastruktura može nositi podatak o kiši i van namenskih meteoroloških senzora.
entries.what_en: Telecom infrastructure can carry rainfall information beyond dedicated weather sensors.
entries.takes_sr: Vodi se kao kandidat za buduće čulo, sa izričitom napomenom da pristup, geometrija i kalibracija u Srbiji nisu utvrđeni — metod nije isto što i dostupan izvor.
entries.takes_en: It is carried as a candidate for a future sense, with the explicit note that access, geometry and calibration in Serbia are unestablished — a method is not the same as an available source.

entries.name: James, P. et al. (2022). Realizing Smart City Infrastructure at Scale, in the Wild. Frontiers in Sustainable Cities 4, 767942.
entries.what_sr: Njukaslova urbana opservatorija: preko 3.600 senzorskih tokova, oko 10.000 osmatranja u minutu, preko deset milijardi zapisa — i sopstvena ocena autora da je usko grlo drugde: „malo ko želi podatke, ono što ljudi zaista žele jeste analiza i uvid“, a ta analiza je i dalje ručna, spora i skupa.
entries.what_en: The Newcastle Urban Observatory: more than 3,600 sensor streams, some 10,000 observations a minute, over ten billion records — and the authors' own verdict that the bottleneck lies elsewhere: “few people want data, what they really want is analysis and insight”, and that analysis remains manual, time consuming and expensive.
entries.takes_sr: Ovo je najjači dokaz da broj instrumenata nije usko grlo. Rad takođe opisuje ono što do table retko stigne — senzor koji se pokvari pa javlja preterane vrednosti, indikativni senzori kojima je dozvoljeno odstupanje do 50% od referentnog, i održavanje koje postaje teret preko određenog broja uređaja. Otuda potvrda i za neuspeh i stanje uz svaku vrednost.
entries.takes_en: This is the strongest evidence that instrument count is not the bottleneck. The paper also describes what rarely reaches a dashboard — a sensor developing a fault and reporting excessive values, indicative sensors permitted to sit within 50% of a reference, and maintenance becoming a burden past a certain number of units. Hence a receipt even for a failure, and a state beside every value.

entries.name: Kitchin, R. & McArdle, G. Urban data and city dashboards: six key issues. Programmable City Working Paper 21.
entries.what_sr: Sistematska kritika gradskih tabli u šest tačaka. Za ovaj rad presudne su dve: metapodaci o kvalitetu podataka gotovo se nikad ne daju, pa tabla traži poverenje bez providnosti; i pokrivenost je tanja nego što izgleda — u sopstvenom dablinskom popisu autori su našli da je samo 10 od 37 indikatora održivosti bilo dostupno na odgovarajućoj razmeri.
entries.what_en: A systematic critique of city dashboards in six issues. Two are decisive here: data quality metadata is rarely provided, so a dashboard demands trust without transparency; and coverage is thinner than it looks — in their own Dublin audit only 10 of 37 sustainability indicators were available at an appropriate scale.
entries.takes_sr: Ovaj projekat je pokušaj da se upravo taj sloj metapodataka napravi za jedan grad, javno: tri vremena, jedno od pet stanja i uhvaćena dozvola uz svaku vrednost. Popis otvorenosti sa 211 zapisa je isti onaj dablinski popis, samo za Beograd.
entries.takes_en: This project is an attempt to build precisely that metadata layer for one city, in public: three times, one of five states and a captured permission beside every value. The audit of openness with its 211 records is that Dublin audit, run for Belgrade.

entries.name: Huang, X. (2025). Geo-hallucination in urban analytics: what it is and why it matters. Environment and Planning B.
entries.what_sr: Definiše geo-halucinaciju kao izlaz modela koji je prostorno nekoherentan ili izmišljen, a deluje autoritativno; razlikuje je od obične greške u podacima jer potiče iz rasuđivanja modela, ne iz merenja, i naziva je epistemičkim i društveno-političkim rizikom za planiranje i upravljanje.
entries.what_en: Defines geo-hallucination as model output that is spatially incoherent or fabricated while appearing authoritative; distinguishes it from ordinary data error because it comes from the model's reasoning rather than the measurement, and calls it an epistemic and socio-political risk for planning and governance.
entries.takes_sr: Ovo je tačno rizik zbog kojeg kapija postoji. Lokalni modeli smeju da koriste samo brojeve iz digesta, moraju da citiraju činjenicu unutar rečenice, ne smeju budućnost da iznesu kao činjenicu, i svaka rečenica se proverava pre nego što je čitalac vidi — a odbijanja se objavljuju kao odbijanja. Doprinos je kapija i zapis, ne model.
entries.takes_en: This is exactly the risk the gate exists for. The local models may use only numbers from the digest, must cite the fact inside the sentence, may not state a forecast as fact, and every utterance is validated before a reader sees it — with refusals published as refusals. The contribution is the gate and the record, not the model.

entries.name: ISO 37120 — Sustainable cities and communities: indicators for city services and quality of life
entries.what_sr: Međunarodni skup indikatora gradskih usluga i kvaliteta života (2018, revidiran 2023); ISO 37122 ga proširuje za takozvane pametne gradove.
entries.what_en: An international set of indicators for city services and quality of life (2018, revised 2023); ISO 37122 extends it for so-called smart cities.
entries.takes_sr: Daje spoljnu meru umesto naše: koliko indikatora Beograd danas uopšte može da odgovori iz javnih izvora, sa kojim kašnjenjem i sa kakvim poreklom. To preslikavanje je predloženo, a nije urađeno — i tako i piše.
entries.takes_en: It supplies an external yardstick instead of our own: how many indicators Belgrade can answer today from open sources, at what latency and with what provenance. That mapping is proposed and not yet performed — and is described as such.
